extracted.CRITICAL_TEETH_FINDING_introductory_pric: The widely-reported '$199/month' figure for Wegovy Pen and Ozempic is attributed by the index to be an INTRODUCTORY price covering only the FIRST TWO MONTHLY FILLS, after which the price RISES to $349/month or higher. A patient who budgets $199/month indefinitely would face a price increase of +$150 to +$300 per month from the third fill onward. Any consumer-facing display of '$199' without the two-fill limitation is actively dangerous.

wegovy_pill.caveat: described as a LIMITED TIME OFFER - time-bounded, expiry date unknown

zepbound_vial.fulfillment: Eli Lilly manages all Zepbound Vial orders through LillyDirect, which confirms eligibility and offers delivery. 'Eligibility is required and terms and conditions apply.'

zepbound_kwikpen.COMPARATOR_CONFLICT: The Zepbound KwikPen product page comparator is reported as $499.00, NOT the ~$1,087 list price reported for the site homepage. $299 vs $499 is 40% off, which is internally consistent. This means the site may display DIFFERENT comparator baselines in different places (list price vs. prior direct-to-consumer self-pay price). Treating $1,087 as 'the' comparator for the $299 figure is not supported.
